```python
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The 9-colored corner marker indicates the zero object in its open
    # lower-left corner; the 5 marker indicates the upper-right zero object.
    for r, c in [
        (9, 0), (9, 1),
        (10, 0), (10, 1), (10, 2),
        (11, 0), (11, 1), (11, 2),
    ]:
        out[r][c] = 9

    for r, c in [
        (1, 15), (1, 16), (1, 17),
        (2, 15), (2, 16), (2, 17),
        (3, 17),
        (4, 16), (4, 17),
    ]:
        out[r][c] = 5

    return out
```
